_doc: Hand decisions applied by scripts/03-build.mjs. parks: keyed by park name (bucket-list or OSM). playgrounds: keyed by OSM ref.

Spruce Park.loc_note: not in OSM; placed at NW 25th St & NW Spruce Ave, the corner the park is named for (approximate)

Varnish Park.loc_note: not in OSM; placed at NW 16th St & NW Varnish Ave, the corner the park is named for (approximate)

Renaissance Ridge Central Park.exclude: subdivision (HOA) park in Renaissance Ridge; not a public park

Ochoco Pointe Basketball Court and Playg.exclude: Ochoco Pointe subdivision amenity (private pool next door); treated as HOA

Panorama Park.note: Crooked River Ranch community park, with restrooms next to the playground. Crooked River Ranch is a private association; check access rules.

High Desert Sports Complex.note: Redmond Area Park and Recreation District sports complex.

Umatilla Sports Complex.note: City of Redmond sports fields with a playground mapped in OpenStreetMap.

Cliff Clemens Park.note: Quiet neighborhood park on Larch Street; its playground opened in 2011 with the first swing set in a Sisters city park.

Coffield Community Center Playground.note: Next to Sisters Park & Recreation District's Coffield Community Center, the skate park and a disc golf course.
